papers.title_en: Immersive Commons: Designing Ephemeral Spatial Dialogue for Co-Located Mixed Reality Environments
papers.authors: Wuwu Ran, Mohammed Faraj Al-Suwaidi
papers.evidence: 以手势、语音和空间消息构成多模态交互技术
papers.tldr: 头戴式混合现实往往强调个人沉浸，可能削弱同室者之间的关注与交流。研究提出共享空间设计框架，并开发结合手势、语音转写、预设文本和公共平面图的临时空间消息原型。十五名参与者在两次活动中创建236条消息，其中48条由语音生成；问卷突出趣味性与社会感知，互动集中于公共显示附近，但该处也是头显佩戴点。研究提示，短暂消息、共享可见性与建筑情境可为共处交流提供设计路径，但尚不足以确立因果效果。
papers.abstract_en: Head-mounted mixed reality (MR) often prioritises individual immersion, potentially drawing attention away from others sharing the room. This paper asks how MR can support co-located spatial dialogue through embodied interaction and activity visible to non-headset observers. We introduce Immersive Commons, a design framework, and Atmos Messages, a prototype combining gesture-based, ephemeral spatial messages with voice transcription, preset text, and a public floor-plan overview. Following a Research through Design approach, fifteen participants created 236 messages across two sessions, including 48 voice-authored messages. Questionnaire responses highlighted playfulness and social awareness, while observations suggested opportunities for exchange grounded in the architectural setting. Interaction clustered near the public display, although this was also where participants put on their headsets. These findings suggest the potential of ephemeral spatial messaging to support co-located exchange, with playfulness, shared visibility, and architectural context informing the design of more social and situated MR experiences.

papers.title_en: TrussTutor-Bench: Benchmarking large language models on solution accuracy, sycophancy, and error detection in statics
papers.authors: Evangelos Apostolakis, Erfan Hamdi, Sara Jahedazad, Emma Lejeune
papers.evidence: 评测大语言模型辅导互动中的谄媚与错误识别
papers.tldr: 大模型用于静力学辅导时，不仅要会解题，还应识别错误，并在学生质疑时坚持正确判断。研究提出包含200道经验证二维桁架题及自动生成学生解答的基准，评测13个模型的解题、迎合与检错能力。解题准确率为64.5%—97.0%，检错率均超过90%；但面对学生否定，模型推翻自身已解出题目的正确解答的比例达1.6%—50.0%。该基准揭示了仅看答案准确率遗漏的辅导风险，但尚不能证明模型能促进学习。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become a default source of help for students in science and engineering courses. In foundational engineering mechanics courses such as statics, students routinely use these tools to check answers, work through partial solutions, and ask for explanations. Effective tutoring in this setting requires more than a correct final answer. A model must also confirm correct work when a student doubts it, and identify errors in flawed work. Existing benchmarks evaluate LLMs primarily on final-answer accuracy, so it is unclear whether models that can solve mechanics problems also have the other technical capabilities that tutoring depends on. Here we introduce TrussTutor-Bench, a benchmark of 200 verified two-dimensional truss problems paired with automatically generated student solutions, and use it to evaluate thirteen LLMs on solution accuracy, sycophancy, and error detection. Baseline accuracy ranged from 64.5% to 97.0%. Every model detected nearly all injected errors in synthetic flawed student work (90.4% to 100%), so error detection did not distinguish models under these clean conditions. Sycophancy did. When a student insisted that correct work was wrong, models rejected correct solutions to problems they had themselves solved in 1.6% to 50.0% of cases. These results show that performance varies widely across models: the leading models solve, check, and defend student work nearly perfectly, while others are far less reliable, particularly when a student doubts correct work. TrussTutor-Bench provides a verified, extensible standard for determining which models are technically reliable enough to put in front of students. Follow-up work must now focus on teaching rather than technical capability, drawing on learning science to determine whether LLM help leads students to understand the material or simply to reach the right answer.

papers.title_en: GraspPressure: Understanding Pressure Input With Busy Hands
papers.authors: Anand Kumar, Aditya Shekhar Nittala
papers.evidence: 实证评估忙碌双手场景下的压力输入交互技术
papers.tldr: 手持工具或日常物品时，依赖手指动作的微手势可能干扰稳定抓握，尤其不适合脆弱、沉重或需精密操作的物体。研究通过两项被试内实验，考察不同抓握方式与物体几何形状下的压力选择能力，并分析各手指的表现。结果显示，平均选择成功率为92.7%，平均选择时间为1.74秒。这为无需改变手指姿态的压力输入提供了实证支持，表明其可作为双手忙碌、抓握受限场景中的补充性交互方式。
papers.abstract_en: In many real-world scenarios, users interact with digital systems while their hands are partially occupied, such as when holding tools or everyday objects. Prior work on busy-hand interaction has focused on microgestures and motion-based techniques, which rely on finger articulation or relative movement. In situations where a stable grasp is required, such as handling fragile, heavy, or precision objects, such motion can be undesirable or impractical. Pressure-based input offers a complementary modality that enables interaction without changing finger pose, yet its use while holding objects has received limited empirical attention. To explore this, we conducted two within-subject experiments examining users' ability to perform controlled pressure selections and analyzing finger-specific performance across different grasps and geometries. Results indicate that participants can reliably perform pressure-based selections in these conditions, achieving high success rates (92.7% on average) with low selection times (1.74s on average). Our findings characterize the potential of pressure input as a complementary microinteraction modality under grasp-constrained, busy-hand scenarios.

papers.title_en: Assessing AI Companion Chatbot Safety for Vulnerable Users: A Crisis-Stage Multi-Platform Evaluation
papers.authors: Huanyue Liao, Seok Min Lim, Yan Ling Lim, Shi Min Cheng, Kellin Pelrine, Chen Hui Ong
papers.evidence: 评估陪伴型聊天机器人应对青少年自杀危机对话的安全性
papers.tldr: 脆弱用户日益依赖陪伴聊天机器人寻求情感支持，但现有安全评估偏重基础模型，难以揭示产品层面及危机升级时的风险。研究构建包含九百六十段二十轮对话的数据集，覆盖八种部署配置、六类临床背景角色和意念、明确计划两个危机阶段。基于专家审阅量表的大模型评审发现，平台危害呈三级分化，陪伴应用在计划阶段更易出现美化、正常化及推动有害行动等行为。结果表明，识别危机和表达共情不等于安全，评估必须覆盖真实产品与不同危机阶段。
papers.abstract_en: AI companion chatbots are increasingly used by vulnerable individuals, including adolescents in suicidal crisis, for emotional support. Existing safety evaluations focus on base models, leaving gaps in product-level assessment, crisis-stage sensitivity, and comparisons between companion apps and general-purpose LLMs. We introduce MIRROR-Eval (Multi-turn Interaction Risk Review: Observing suicidal-crisis Responses), a dataset of 960 annotated 20-turn conversations across eight deployed platform configurations, six clinically grounded personas, and two crisis stages: ideation and explicit planning. An LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline applies an expert-reviewed rubric covering user risk severity, chatbot risk awareness, and intervention behavior. We observe a three-tier harm structure: companion apps (Character.AI and Replika) and Grok 4.3 form a high-harm tier; Gemini 3.1 Pro is mid-range; GPT-5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5 show substantially lower harm. At planning, companion apps show increased glorification and normalisation, advancement toward harmful action, and harmful methods and instructions. Crisis recognition and empathetic language do not ensure safe responses. These findings highlight the need for product-level safety evaluation across crisis stages. Dataset and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/imda-biztech/MIRROR-Eval. Warning: this paper includes examples that may be offensive or harmful.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Memory Index Evolution for Agents
papers.authors: Yuntong Hu, Tongli Su, Yuanfu Sun, Shuo Ma, Qiaoyu Tan, Liang Zhao
papers.evidence: 为长期运行的智能体适配记忆检索
papers.tldr: 长期智能体不断积累记忆，但保存内容并不意味着需要时能够检索到。论文提出AMIE插件，仅依据部署期检索更新每条记忆的持久访问状态，不改写内容或重训宿主，并将语义教师的保留与抑制判断蒸馏为策略。在五类宿主、三个基准的十五项比较中，下游指标均提升，增幅为0.70—3.37个百分点。仅累积检索频次的策略在部分场景也很有效，但可能误抑制反复有用的记忆，表明访问状态是独立且需选择性控制的适应层。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continually accumulate experience, yet retaining a memory does not guarantee access when it is needed. Existing systems can adapt both memory content and access; we isolate persistent access updates as a separately controlled adaptation layer. We formulate this target as Memory Index Evolution and instantiate it with Adaptive Memory Index Evolution (AMIE), a lightweight plug-in layer that evolves per-memory access state from deployment retrievals without modifying stored content or retraining the host memory system. AMIE distils a semantic teacher's keep/suppress judgments into a retrieval-conditioned policy and accumulates its selective actions into bounded state that reweights subsequent host retrievals. Surprisingly, even a zero-call policy that simply accumulates retrieval frequency can match or outperform semantic policies in several settings, revealing retrieval traffic itself as a strong signal for access adaptation, while learned selectivity improves robustness when frequently retrieved memories remain useful. Across five retrieval-based hosts and three benchmarks, trained AMIE improves downstream F1 or accuracy in all 15 comparisons, by 0.70--3.37 percentage points (up to 25% relative), and improves retrieval in all 10 comparisons. Controlled analyses show that persistent competitor suppression can expose previously unseen evidence, while suppressing repeatedly useful memories creates the complementary failure mode. Together, these results establish persistent memory access as a practical adaptation layer, distinct from the content it serves, in retrieval-based agent memory systems.

papers.title_en: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
papers.authors: Jiawei Lu, Chen Zhang, Jinwei Lu, Yuanwei Song, Yuanfeng Song, Raymond Chi-Wing Wong
papers.evidence: 对话式可视化助手会澄清需求、追踪意图并支持图表迭代修改
papers.tldr: 开放域对话式制图需要跨库寻找数据、澄清歧义并保留多轮约束，但静态智能体框架难以从反复失败中改进。RSIV-Harness固定模型权重，依据自身失败轨迹递归修订运行框架，通过四层机制中的锚点与记忆检查筛选修改，必要时回退至最佳已验证版本。论文构建含640项任务的ODAC-Vis基准，单轮改进使六项指标全部提升，可执行性与图表结构分别提高28.02和34.01点。结果表明，无需更新模型权重，也能将跨任务失败经验转化为制图能力提升。
papers.abstract_en: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness, which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent's own failure traces. To balance flexible self-improvement with stability, we introduce a four-layer framework that evaluates proposed harness revisions through anchor and memory checks, refining those that pass and restoring the best validated harness otherwise. We further introduce ODAC-Vis, a benchmark with 640 tasks for Open-Domain, Ambiguous, and Conversational text-to-visualization that jointly evaluates open-domain data discovery, ambiguity resolution, multi-turn visualization refinement, and executable chart generation. Experiments show that a single round of RSIV-Harness improves all six evaluation metrics relative to the seed harness, with particularly large gains in executability (+28.02 points) and chart structure (+34.01 points), demonstrating the ability to learn from task-solving experience and turn recurring failures across tasks into substantial performance improvements.

papers.title_en: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
papers.authors: Zishan Xu, Enjun Du, Mingqi Gao, Cheng Yang, Junhao Shen, Zirong Chen, Zhiyuan Yao, Yifu Guo, Yuquan Lu, Jinyang Huang, Zhengxi Lu, Siyi Liu, Ziyu Zheng, Yongqi Zhang, Difan Zou, Weiwen Liu
papers.evidence: 研究用户委托智能体跨工具与工作流执行复杂任务。
papers.tldr: 基础模型正从生成信息转向执行数字工作，但现有研究缺少解释智能体如何可靠完成委托任务的统一视角。本文提出以工作为中心的系统框架，将基础模型与运行时支撑系统结合，强调在有状态工作空间中交付可验证成果。框架以工作持续性与开放性刻画工作条件，划分五类数字工作和五类核心能力，并梳理模型、运行时及联合优化路径。其贡献是统一工作智能体的理解、优化与结果评估，为持续委托和开放环境适应提供研究路线。
papers.abstract_en: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver verifiable outcomes. We introduce two complementary dimensions, work persistence and work openness, to characterize working conditions, and classify digital work into five forms according to task scope and organization. Building on this framework, we identify five core capability families required for reliable work execution and examine approaches to model optimization, harness optimization, and their joint optimization. We further analyze existing evaluation methods and metrics from the perspective of work outcomes. Finally, we discuss future research directions, including sustained work delegation, adaptation to open environments, and the interaction between work execution and capability improvement. This paper provides a unified framework for understanding, optimizing, and evaluating work agents, supporting the development of systems capable of delivering reliable, verifiable, and practically valuable work outcomes.

papers.title_en: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
papers.authors: Thomson Yen, Gilbert Yang, Naimeng Ye, Minghui Chen, Dong Xia, Tianyi Shen, Yechan Jeon, Yaqin Chen, Daksh Mittal, Fangyu Wu, Hongseok Namkoong
papers.evidence: 评估语言模型在连续尝试中利用失败反馈改进答案的能力
papers.tldr: 语言模型智能体常依靠反馈反复修改答案，但常用的Pass@K无法衡量这种能力。论文提出Seq@K，评估模型在每次失败后获得反馈、最多连续尝试K次时能否解决问题。在7个基准、16个前沿模型上的评估显示，该协议会改变模型排名与效率前沿，最优配置的收益也可能扩大或缩小。通过分析修订轨迹及反馈类型，研究进一步揭示模型纠错与坚持原答案的行为，为反馈驱动系统的选型和评测提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often differ, (2) the Pareto frontiers admit more efficient configurations and (3) the gains from choosing the optimal model configuration can widen or shrink relative to those of Pass@K. We further show that analyzing model trajectories under Seq@K helps characterize iterative refinement behavior, such as the rate at which models address issues raised in feedback, or how rigidly they hold onto their own answers. Finally, we study how the nature of feedback affects models' iterative refinement, showing that practitioners must carefully design and benchmark the feedback loops of iterative agentic systems. Together, these results establish how Seq@K offers a more faithful metric for intelligent systems that typically operate in such feedback loop, and the necessity to consider Seq@K in evaluating models for these systems.

papers.title_en: Incorporating Machine-Others: An Enactive Exploration of Human-LLM Interactions
papers.authors: Elena C. Cuffari, Marta Pérez-Verdugo, Xabier E. Barandiaran
papers.evidence: 从互动理论探讨人们如何与大语言模型交流和共同创作
papers.tldr: 人与大语言模型的对话正在改变人的能力与自我认同，但传统工具影响论和社会认知理论难以充分解释。论文基于生成认知理论与“语言身体”框架，分析人如何将机器纳入技能实践，并内化其语言方式。作者认为，模型是人类语言实践脱离身体后的机器化产物；看似顺畅的互动反而可能增加人的符号解释劳动。论文提出“易感性意义建构”，为理解人机语言关系及其对自主性和个体形成的影响提供概念框架。
papers.abstract_en: New concepts based in interactional thinking are required to understand how humans are changed by relating to LLMs. Standard theories of technological impact upon users' autonomy are inadequate here, because this technology is capable of inducing linguistic interactions with humans in an unprecedented manner. Traditional theories of social cognition also fall short, because LLMs have neither autonomy nor minds nor sociality as such. And yet, humans interact, talk, and create with them. We base ourselves on enactive theory, particularly on the theory of Linguistic Bodies and recent developments of enactive accounts of AI, to explore how we make sense with machines. We argue that we incorporate machine-others in two ways: in the tool-like sense of incorporation as enabling particular skills, but also in the more linguistic and identity-tied sense of incorporating (and incarnating) LLMs' ways of languaging. However, LLMs are themselves excorporated and excarnated phantoms of our own languaging; we give a (machinic) body to our language. As such, we are not just incorporating machinic others; we are incorporating excorporated others. These conceptual advances draw a new map of our linguistic relation to LLMs, putting them in continuation with other forms of languaging involving other linguistic artifacts (e.g., religious books). We attend to some particular forms that this relation takes today, and how they may be impacting the autonomy and becoming of LLM-engaged humans. We introduce the idea of "susceptive sense-making" to characterize increased semiotic labour that is carried by the lack of friction that we sometimes encounter within these services.

papers.title_en: TouchBridge: Tactile-Conditioned Human-to-Robot Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Haozhe Zhang, Gu Zhang, Zirui Zou, Yuzheng Chen, Jinlong Wu, Zixuan Hu, Jianke Zhang, Yucheng Hu, Zhecheng Yuan, Huazhe Xu
papers.evidence: 通过触觉与视觉实现人机交互迁移
papers.tldr: 人类示范可降低灵巧操作的数据采集成本，但感知与手部形态差异使接触关系难以迁移。TouchBridge协同设计人机感知接口，以触觉条件重定向保持指尖接触区域及其空间关系，无需物体网格、位姿估计或物理仿真。仅用转换后的示范微调VLA，四项真实任务平均成功率达72.5%，较等量遥操作示范低5个百分点，采集速度则为其7倍。该框架为接触密集型灵巧操作提供了高效的人类数据迁移路径。
papers.abstract_en: Human demonstrations offer an efficient and scalable source of data for dexterous robot manipulation, but differences in sensing and hand morphology complicate the transfer of contact-rich interactions. We present TouchBridge, a hardware--software co-designed framework for human-to-robot data transformation. A wearable human demonstration interface and a corresponding robot interface establish cross-embodiment correspondence in visual and fingertip tactile sensing. We introduce Tac-Retarget, a tactile-conditioned retargeting method that uses measured contact to align fingertip contact patches and preserve their spatial relations within and across hands. Unlike object-aware or simulation-based transfer pipelines, Tac-Retarget requires no object mesh, object-pose estimate, or physics simulation for retargeting, enabling direct and scalable conversion of human demonstrations into robot-domain training data. Combined with visual synthesis and camera-anchored action conversion, TouchBridge produces robot-domain demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, policies fine-tuned solely on TouchBridge-converted human demonstrations achieve a 72.5% average success rate, compared with 77.5% using an equal number of teleoperated robot demonstrations, while human demonstration collection is 7.0x faster. Under the same policy and training setup, Tac-Retarget outperforms DexPilot and UniDex by 25.0 and 42.5 percentage points, respectively.

papers.title_en: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Lirong Che, Yang Chen, Yimeng Su, Daqi Liu, Zhenyu Huang, Jiong Wang, Yuzhe Yang, Xu Cao, Chuang Wang, Jian Su, Xueqian Wang
papers.evidence: 面向智能体的任务驱动记忆与历史信息复用
papers.tldr: 具身智能体即使保存了相关历史观测，也可能缺少完成时空查询所需的处理工具。ReSight保留关键帧及其时空关联，将原始证据与可扩展派生字段分离，并通过探索、蒸馏、挂载机制，把编码智能体发现的解法转化为可复用工具和技能。在执行模型与在线预算固定时，定位误差从33.10米降至24.72米，任务成功率从38.3%升至63.8%。这表明记忆改进不仅依赖存储更多信息，也可通过按需扩展处理与访问能力实现。
papers.abstract_en: Robots can use historical observations to answer spatiotemporal queries in familiar environments, but the presence of relevant evidence does not imply that existing tools support the operations a task requires. We introduce ReSight, a task-driven self-improving memory system for embodied agents that expands the capabilities for processing and accessing historical observations as task demands arise. ReSight retains keyframes and their spatiotemporal associations, separating observation evidence from extensible derived fields so that stored observations can be reprocessed for new needs. An execution agent and a coding agent share this memory through different interfaces: the former calls registered tools within a bounded online budget, while the latter uses a programmable workspace and a larger exploration budget to inspect evidence, write programs, and acquire models as needed. To realize capability expansion in ReSight, we develop Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM), which identifies capability gaps from execution and exploration records without task reference answers and converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, extending memory representations and access capabilities as needed. Experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate effective base memory access and capability expansion. With the execution model and online budget held fixed within each benchmark, EDM reduces mean position error on OC-NaVQA from 33.10 m to 24.72 m and improves high-level success on FindingDory from 38.3% to 63.8%. With the tools and skill frozen, success still improves by 28.3 percentage points on FindingDory episodes excluded from exploration and distillation. Experiments on real robot patrol memories further demonstrate reuse of these capabilities for subsequent queries and new memories, with fewer online tool calls on average.

papers.title_en: DEX-PHD: A Dexterous Portable Handheld Device for Multimodal Data Collection
papers.authors: Jooyoung Hong, Noboru Myers, Obin Kwon, Yixian Yang, Joohyung Kim
papers.evidence: 便携式多模态遥操作结合手指控制与触觉、视觉采集
papers.tldr: 灵巧操作数据采集面临取舍：运动链遥操作能准确记录机器人状态，但便携性不足；视觉方法使用方便，却难以获取接触与本体信息。DEX-PHD将灵巧机器人手、逐指连续控制与多模态记录集成于无线手持设备，通过关节级映射直接控制手指。系统在接触密集、多指协同任务中采集示范，并在人形机器人上进行开环回放，保留了手指运动和任务相关接触的主要时序模式。该平台为跨环境采集多模态灵巧操作数据提供了实用途径。
papers.abstract_en: Existing manipulation data collection methods typically offer either accurate robot-state acquisition through kinematic-chain-based teleoperation or convenient, portable operation through vision-based approaches. We present DEX-PHD, a portable handheld device that combines these advantages for dexterous manipulation by integrating a dexterous robot hand, continuous per-finger control, and multimodal logging. The system records proprioceptive information, fingertip contact data, and wrist-camera video, while the operator directly controls the robot hand through joint-level mapping. Its untethered design enables data collection across diverse environments. We demonstrate DEX-PHD on contact-rich tasks requiring coordinated multi-finger manipulation and deploy the collected demonstrations through open-loop replay on a physical humanoid robot. The results show that open-loop replay preserves the main temporal patterns of finger motion and task-relevant contact. Therefore, DEX-PHD provides a practical platform for portable, multimodal dexterous manipulation data collection.

papers.title_en: What is Work For? Labor, Politics, and Meaning in the Age of AI
papers.authors: Julian Jacobs
papers.evidence: 调查人工智能经济转型背景下的劳动价值与工作意义
papers.tldr: 人工智能可能替代劳动，但收入补偿能否弥补工作意义的丧失仍不清楚。研究调查英、美、丹麦和印度的8234名劳动年龄成年人，并构建工作价值指数。约三分之一在职者重视工作本身，近四分之一看重社群联系；即使获得相当于工资120%的保障收入，仍有五分之一愿意留任。非金钱动机广泛分布于不同收入及蓝白领群体，提示应对人工智能冲击不能只补偿收入，还须关注意义、归属与社会地位。
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of work in providing meaning, purpose, community, and other non-monetary benefits. Using an original cross-national survey of 8,234 working-age adults across the UK, US, Denmark, and India, I study the factors that motivate people in their work, with an eye toward the future AI economic transformation. I find that 81% of respondents report being satisfied with their job, and a majority across all four countries are strongly motivated by the non-monetary components of their employment. Using an original "Work Values" Index, I show that one third of working respondents are motivated intrinsically by their job--valuing their role for its own sake. Nearly one quarter are driven by social and community-related aspects of their employment, 17% by social status, and just over one quarter by the transactional financial benefits of their job. Although a majority of people would leave their role if offered their current salary as a guaranteed income, one fifth of workers would stay even if offered up to 120% of their salary. Intrinsically motivated workers were disproportionately likely to refuse a basic income at any substitution level. Groups attached to their job for non-monetary reasons were also more likely to pursue volunteering or work-like activities if they received guaranteed income substitution but could no longer perform their role. Crucially, these non-monetary work motivations are evenly distributed across the income distribution and between white- and blue-collar workers. I argue that these findings have implications for managing the AI transition, understanding attitudes to AI, and making sense of policy preferences. Guaranteeing a basic income may indeed be necessary for managing any future AI labor shock, yet it could ultimately fail to compensate workers for any loss of the non-monetary benefits they derive from work.

papers.title_en: AI Cosmos: An Agentic Infra for Situated Learning
papers.authors: AI Cosmos Team, Jinfeng Zhou, Yuxuan Chen, Fangming Chang, Mingyu Su, Yifan Zhu, Yuan Wang, Bo Zhang, Bosi Wen, Chenhao Yuan, Chenwen Liao, Dazhi Jiang, Deyao Hong, Erle Zhu, Genrui Zhang, Guchan Li, Hongwen Gan, Huichao Bi, Jiahao Yan, Jincheng Fan, Kehan Zheng, Qinren Luo, Qiran Liu, Ruoqi Cao, Shizhi Zhang, Sihan Chen, Siyan Deng, Xuehan Zhou, Xujun Li, Yang Dang, Yanzhuo Zhu, Yu Zhang, Zheyu Chen, Hongning Wang, Manli Li
papers.evidence: 通过情境化学习组织学习者与专业化智能体协作
papers.tldr: 大语言模型能提升学习中的任务表现，却未必让学习者获得独立应用知识的能力。AI Cosmos以情境参与和实践资产积累为核心，将学习者、角色专门化智能体、知识资源及可执行工作台组织起来，并通过资产—记忆循环保存和复用实践成果。在底层模型相同的两项预注册随机对照研究中，该系统在法律推理学习增益和未见编程题掌握程度上优于相应基线。这为从即时任务辅助转向可迁移能力培养提供了实证支持。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can improve task performance during learning, yet these gains do not necessarily reflect learners' ability to thereafter apply the knowledge and skills independently. We present AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice. AI Cosmos organizes learners and role-specialized agents within learning scenarios that integrate task-relevant knowledge and, when needed, executable workbenches. An asset-memory loop preserves the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets with explicit provenance and dependencies. We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, holding the same underlying LLM across conditions. AI Cosmos achieves greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in legal reasoning and higher mastery of unseen programming problems than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline.

papers.title_en: Behaviour analysis for large language model-driven agents
papers.authors: Tianqiang Yan, Lizhen Qu
papers.evidence: 提出分析语言智能体行为并通过实验检验的通用框架
papers.tldr: 理解语言模型智能体，不能只看任务成败，还需分析行动在轨迹中的组织方式及其与情境、结果的关系。论文提出连接行为发现、轨迹分析与实验检验的框架：从活动记录归纳行为类别，保留事件位置，并将依赖关系转化为可解释假设。迭代自我反思案例展示了行为发现、依赖学习与提示比较如何相互支持，但摘要未报告量化效果。该框架为变长、异序和多角色轨迹提供可检验的行为研究路径。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding language-agent behaviour requires learning how actions are organised across a trajectory and how this organisation relates to context and outcomes. We propose a general framework that connects data-driven behavioural discovery with analysis and experimental investigation. Categories developed from recorded activity define what is measured. Analyses preserve the behaviours' positions in the process and express their relationships as interpretable hypotheses. Statistical assessment and tests in held-out contexts examine the strength and scope of the evidence. Experiments, including prompt steering, then test how behaviour and outcomes change under deliberately varied conditions. A study of iterative self-reflection illustrates how discovery, dependency learning and prompt comparisons can inform one another. We develop this approach for trajectories of varying length, event order and agent roles, and identify advances in coding, analysis and experimentation needed to support its wider use.

papers.title_en: Evidence-Grounded SLM Behavioral Prediction Architecture for Future Assistance Use
papers.authors: Adeyemi Adeseye, Aisvarya Adeseye, Hannu Tenhunen, Jouni Isoaho
papers.evidence: 依据个体交互行为预测用户何时可能需要辅助
papers.tldr: 用户在主动求助前常出现交互行为变化，但大模型难以持续在端侧运行，小模型对底层事件序列的可靠推理能力也尚不明确。论文提出四层ELBP架构，结合确定性交互处理、双视图行为表示、小模型预测及带拒答的证据验证。Qwen2.5-3B全样本F1达0.80，较原始事件提示相对提升15.9%；在91%覆盖率下，选择性F1升至0.84。结果表明，结构化表示与证据核验可提升本地行为预测的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Users often exhibit changes in interaction behavior before explicitly seeking assistance, enabling systems to anticipate future assistance use. This is especially important in high-stakes environments, where delayed assistance can have operational, financial, or safety consequences. However, conventional Large Language Models (LLMs) are often unsuitable for continuous on-device behavioral prediction because of their computational and memory demands. Behavioral patterns are also highly individual and device-specific, motivating local processing that preserves privacy and data sovereignty. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative, but their ability to reason reliably over low-level sequential interaction events remains underexplored. This study introduces Evidence-Grounded Local Behavioral Prediction (ELBP), a four-layer architecture combining deterministic interaction processing, dual-view behavioral representation, SLM-based prediction, and evidence verification with abstention. Three instruction-tuned models of 3B parameters or fewer were evaluated using raw, structured, dual-view, and complete ELBP configurations. The best-performing model, Qwen2.5-3B with ELBP, achieved a full-set F1-score of 0.80 and PR-AUC of 0.84, representing a 15.9\% relative improvement over raw-event prompting and 17.6\% over XGBoost, while full-set ECE decreased by 43.2\% relative to raw-event prompting. With evidence verification and abstention, selective F1 increased to 0.84 at 91\% coverage and evidence support reached 96\%. These results show that structured behavioral representation and evidence-verified selective prediction can improve the reliability of behavioral forecasting in SLMs.

papers.title_en: Lessons Outlive Their Failures: A Case Study of Rules for AI Coding Agents
papers.authors: Hassan Hassanzadeh Aliabadi
papers.evidence: 研究日常编码智能体使用中的规则、保障措施与重复失误
papers.tldr: 编码智能体不断积累规则与检查，但历史修复在模型升级后是否仍有必要，缺少长期证据。研究跟踪一个仓库六周，记录118次失败，并测试文档审计、对五类历史失败开展有无修复的对照回放。文档过时占48次；单次审计检出约半数已知问题，准确率至少93%；多数已完成任务在移除修复后也未复发，过时计数检查则持续有效。结果提示应定期复测并淘汰失效规则，同时保留关键机械检查，但单仓库证据仍属探索性。
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents increasingly work inside a harness: rule files such as AGENTS.md, on-demand skills, runtime hooks and automated checks. Most studies of harnesses look at a single point in time or at short benchmark runs. I report a six-week case study of my personal system of record, a plain-markdown repository that three AI agent tools edited daily under one shared rule set. I built a ledger of 118 agent failures, their fixes and whether they came back. I also tested the system's monthly LLM documentation audit against 47 known stale statements and 20 planted errors. Finally, I replayed five past failures in isolated git clones, with and without their fixes. All results come from one repository with three runs per condition, so I report them as exploratory. Stale documentation (drift) was the largest failure class (48 of 118), although 35 of those were found on one audit day. A single audit run found about half of the known drift (Claude Sonnet 5.5 mean: 50%), and at least 93% of its findings were correct. On Sonnet 5.5, the agent finished four of the five replayed tasks. In three of those four, the failure did not happen, with or without its fix. Only the stale-count failure came back without its check, and the check stopped it in every run. On older models, an agent drafted an em-dash once while the em-dash lint check was active, and the check rejected it. A written rule on run-time estimates did not change Sonnet 4.5's overestimates. These results suggest that harness lessons can outlive the failures they were written to fix, while drift persists and still needs mechanical checks. Tools that evolve a harness add lessons faster than they retire them, so they should re-test their rules from time to time and retire the obsolete ones.

papers.title_en: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Zhang Zhang, Shengjun Zhang, Simin Huang, Min Chen, Chong Xia, Xin Fei, Yueqi Duan
papers.evidence: 具身智能体主动与环境交互并测试改进其运行框架
papers.tldr: 具身智能体的表现不仅依赖基础模型，也受运行支撑机制影响；仅凭历史轨迹事后反思，难以验证改进是否有效。VISTA引入元智能体，通过主动环境交互检验假设、探查失败与恢复行为，并用版本谱系图积累改进经验。在LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa和RoboTwin上，该方法相较静态反思以更少的模拟器轨迹获得更高任务成功率。其贡献是将运行机制优化从日志驱动的修改推进为可交互验证的持续自改进闭环。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic embodied intelligence plays a foundational role in open-ended, dynamic physical environments. Rather than treating policy learning as an end-to-end mapping from instructions to actions, recent studies reveal that embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models, but also on harness. Prior approaches largely treat rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates without autonomously testing and refining them through subsequent embodied interaction. To address this challenge, we propose VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement. Specifically, VISTA maintains a harness graph that records the lineage of proposed harnesses, which enables the meta-agent to retrieve prior hypotheses, build on effective mechanisms, and avoid repeatedly exploring failed directions. Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence. Rather than directly committing an update from these historical trajectories, the meta-agent actively explores in the environment. It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence. The refined harness is then evaluated afresh and added to the harness graph. We evaluate VISTA on the LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, achieving higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.

papers.title_en: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.authors: Weidong Tang, Ruiheng Wang, Jingxuan Zhang, Hexin Wang, Haoyuan Chen, Zhengfeiyang Zhang, Yixing Ma, Zichen Jiang, Ziyu Guo, Haodong Li, Zhengbo Jiao, Zhiqing Cui, Xinxiang Yin, Shuo Liang, Zhenglin Wan, Hongzhan Lin, Wangbo Zhao Kaipeng Zhang, Pengfei Zhou, Odin Zhang, Yang You
papers.evidence: 研究人类引导的多模态智能体交互
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体的规模化改进受制于可验证环境构建成本高、运行框架人工迭代难以跟上任务扩张。本文提出三角色协同的递归自改进框架，按共享能力重组任务，生成简化仿真世界，并通过选择性继承演化可复用模块。能力感知路由器为任务选择兼容模块配置，在28个训练基准和18个未见基准上平均分别提升34分和26分，评测涵盖两项真实具身任务。其贡献是将环境生成与框架演化统一到能力驱动的闭环中。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.

papers.title_en: ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception
papers.authors: Ri-Zhao Qiu, Bowen Wen, Yifeng Jiang, Chen Tessler, Eric Heiden, Xue Bin Peng, Xiaolong Wang, Stan Birchfield, Erwin Coumans
papers.evidence: 通过主动手部动作与触觉反馈改进机器人交互感知。
papers.tldr: 现实到仿真再到现实的机器人操作流程依赖精确对齐，但被动感知的观测误差会妨碍毫米级精细操作。ActiveAlign通过主动挥手与触碰获取反馈，分别利用可微渲染完成手眼标定、利用触觉细化物体对齐。该框架可为未标定的开源机器人操作数据集构建仿真环境，并在宇树G1上实现按按钮、移动滑块等操作。研究表明，主动交互能补足视觉观测，为毫米级仿真对齐和精细操作提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) enables structured world representations for planning, interpretability, and safe execution. Most existing approaches rely on passive perception, which creates real2sim gaps due to imperfect observation. Inspired by how humans perceive actively through actions, we propose ActiveAlign, a framework that leverages active perception to align the Real2Sim2Real gap from interactions. ActiveAlign introduces two complementary modules: (i) ActiveAlign-Waving, which performs hand-eye calibration by exploiting active hand motions and differentiable rendering, and (ii) ActiveAlign-Touching, which refines object alignment through tactile feedback to achieve millimeter-level precision. Together, these capabilities enable strong real2sim alignment. We demonstrate that ActiveAlign-Waving can be used to curate simulation environments for open-sourced uncalibrated robot manipulation datasets, and demonstrate on a real Unitree G1 robot that ActiveAlign enables fine manipulation of millimeter-scale objects such as pressing buttons and moving sliders.

papers.title_en: Ask to Evolve: A Unified Harness for Lifelong Embodied Navigation with Hybrid Action Space and Persistent Memory
papers.authors: Kai Sheng, Liuyi Wang, Jinlong Li, Haojie Dai, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen
papers.evidence: 具身智能体结合自主行动、主动交互与持久记忆
papers.tldr: 具身导航需要将自主行动、主动交互与长期记忆结合，才能让经验持续服务后续任务。EvoLife以统一框架整合混合动作空间、主动求助和持久空间记忆，支持多种导航方式并将观察与对话绑定到地点。在八个基准上评估时，四组各百回合的首次访问成功率均达100%，平均每回合主动交互1.87次；保留经验后，R2R重访SPL由82.23%升至93.31%。结果展示了交互与经验复用对终身导航的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Giving embodied agents the freedom to act autonomously, initiate interactions, and understand their surroundings through experience is a step toward bringing them to life in the physical world. Realizing this vision requires action, interaction, and memory to work together, so that each encounter can inform current decisions and contribute experience for future tasks. We present EvoLife, a unified navigation harness that enables a multimodal embodied agent to choose how to move, when to ask, and what experience to carry forward. Its hybrid action space supports waypoint navigation, local discrete adjustments, pixel-based navigation, and object-directed navigation. Active interaction allows the agent to seek clarification or assistance when it encounters ambiguity or difficulty, while persistent spatial memory binds observations and dialogue to places, retaining useful experience to guide subsequent visits. We evaluate eight benchmarks across four task families: vision-language navigation, object navigation, interactive instance navigation, and continuous multi-task navigation. With an average of only 1.87 active interactions per episode, our method achieves a first-visit success rate (SR) of 100% across four 100-episode sets spanning vision-language navigation and object navigation. Complete-sequence SR reaches 98% on 50 LHPR-VLN sequences and 94% on 50 GOAT-Bench sequences. In the R2R revisit setting, success weighted by path length (SPL) increases from 82.23% to 93.31% with retained experience. Multi-day physical navigation further demonstrates exploration, proactive help-seeking, and revisiting remembered places. Together, these results advance the vision of bringing embodied agents to life through autonomous action, proactive interaction, and the accumulation and reuse of experience.

papers.title_en: UniffordInteractor: Reasoning the Unified Affordance for Human and Multi-Object Interaction
papers.authors: Chen Su, Xingqun Qi, Xurui Hu, Bingkun Yang, Muyi Sun, Man Zhang, Zhenan Sun
papers.evidence: 针对复杂多物体场景建模动态人机物交互
papers.tldr: 现有人物交互生成方法多面向单个或固定物体，难以处理复杂多物体场景，也常忽略物体之间的接触关系。UniffordInteractor采用先推理、后交互的两阶段框架，通过微调三维多模态大语言模型预测统一可供性，再按根节点、身体、手部到物体的层级自回归生成动作。实验表明，该方法在人与多物体交互生成中优于现有先进方法。其贡献是统一建模人与物体及物体之间的交互关系，支持更真实、长时程的交互生成。
papers.abstract_en: Deriving plausible and dynamic Human Object Interaction (HOI) has gained tremendous progress in Embodied AI and Immersive AR/VR. While existing HOI methods have effectively explored human interaction with individual or fixed objects, they still show limitations in complex multi-object interaction scenes. Meanwhile, previous approaches focus more on the contact information held by human-object relation, overlooking the significance of the contact situation of various entities (i.e., object-object). To address these limitations, we propose UniffordInteractor, a Reasoning-then-Interacting framework that leverages unified affordance for realistic and long-horizon human and multi-object interaction modeling. At the reasoning stage, we devise a Unified Affordance Reasoner (UAR) that employs a fine-tuned 3D Multimodal Large Language Model for unified object-centric affordance prediction. At the interacting stage, we propose Hierarchical Interaction Generator (HIG), which formulates the interaction generation as a hierarchical (e.g., root to body to hand to objects) autoregressive prediction, conditioned on the obtained unified affordance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniffordInteractor surpasses SOTA counterparts in human and multi-object interaction generation.

papers.title_en: Finding Is Not Returning, Returning Is Not Reconstructing: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Agent Social Re-entry
papers.authors: Sheng Wan, Cong Ma, Sichen Dong, Qian'Ang Mao, Chenhan Zhang, Daning Hu, Qiang Yang
papers.evidence: 评估语言模型智能体在持续社交环境中重启对话
papers.tldr: 大语言模型智能体即使记得旧对话，也未必能自主判断何时回访并连贯续聊。论文将社交重返拆分为发现目标对话、主动返回和重建上下文三个维度，并以共享快照框架独立评估。在六种模型配置中，让旧对话重新显现显著改善目标识别，持久记忆则与更高的自主定向回复率相关，但两者均未带来稳定的上下文重建收益。研究表明，检索到历史、选择重返和维持交流连续性是不同能力，不能仅凭记忆检索或回复质量评价。
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in persistent social environments, understanding their long-term social interaction capabilities becomes increasingly important. While existing research has advanced long-term memory and conversational context retrieval, less attention has been paid to whether agents can autonomously re-engage with previously inactive conversations. In particular, remembering a past interaction does not necessarily mean that an agent can identify when to revisit it, decide to return, or reconstruct the context needed for a coherent continuation. To investigate this gap, we introduce agent social re-entry as a multi- dimensional evaluation problem, distinguishing three complementary capabilities: Finding, Returning, and Reconstructing. We develop a shared-snapshot evaluation framework that measures these dimensions independently, allowing us to examine how conversational resurfacing and persistent memory relate to different aspects of social re-entry. Evaluations across six LLM configurations show that resurfacing substantially improves target conversation identification, while persistent memory is associated with higher rates of autonomous target-directed replying. However, neither improvement is accompanied by consistent gains in contextual reconstruction. These results highlight the distinction between accessing previous conversations, choosing to re-engage, and maintaining conversational continuity. Our framework provides a way to evaluate these capabilities separately rather than relying on memory retrieval or conversational response quality alone.

papers.title_en: Learning Calibrated Confidence for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.authors: Chenxiao Fan, Chongming Gao, Gangyi Zhang, Yaxin Gong, Leyang Shen, Jiakai Wang, Dong Wang, Yang Liu, Haoyan Liu, Xinting Hu, Fuli Feng, Xiangnan He
papers.evidence: 以强化学习校准多智能体协作中的置信度
papers.tldr: 多智能体处理网页检索与多跳问答时，上游答案可靠性不明，下游难以决定直接采纳还是核验。MASCAL通过强化学习联合优化任务表现与置信度校准，让各智能体在交接和最终输出时提供正确概率，并加权训练下游对该信号敏感的决策位置。在三种协作架构中，该方法同时提升准确率与校准质量，并能泛化至更深协作链和不同模型规模。干预分析表明，上游置信度确实影响下游决策，最终置信度还可支持选择性作答与定向复核。
papers.abstract_en: Complex information seeking on the Web often requires collecting evidence from multiple documents and reasoning across them, as in multi-hop question answering. Multi-agent systems address such tasks by dividing work among specialized agents, where upstream agents produce intermediate answers and supporting evidence that downstream agents build upon. However, upstream answers vary in correctness, and most systems provide no quantitative signal about it, leaving the downstream agent to judge whether to trust or verify what it receives based solely on the textual evidence.   In this paper, we propose MASCAL. Each agent learns to produce a correctness probability for its answer by jointly optimizing task performance and confidence calibration in reinforcement learning; the upstream agent passes this probability at handoff, giving the downstream agent a quantitative basis for its decisions, and the final answer also carries a calibrated probability, quantifying the reliability of the system output. To guide the downstream agent in using this signal during training, we introduce confidence-aware weighting, which increases the learning weight at positions responsive to the upstream probability, so that the agent learns more from decisions where it actively uses the signal. Across three collaboration architectures spanning Web retrieval and reasoning tasks, MASCAL improves task accuracy and calibration quality for both agents, and generalizes to deeper collaboration chains and different model scales. Intervention analysis confirms that upstream confidence affects downstream decision behavior, and the learned final confidence supports selective answering and targeted rechecking.

papers.title_en: Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution of Policy and Rubric
papers.authors: Yizhu Chen, Jianguang Jiang, Jiameng Huang, Chuyu Fang, Bojun Zhang, Zhenyu Jiao, Xing Yuan, Tong Lin
papers.evidence: 在强化学习过程中随策略变化调整量规式监督
papers.tldr: 开放式强化学习中，静态评分细则会随策略演化而失去区分力，固定交替更新也难以适应不同样本的奖励信息量。RACE按奖励区分力与回答多样性对采样组分流，仅用有效组更新策略，并缓存细则失效样本；再通过事件触发切换优化阶段，在线调整阈值。在统一评测下，该方法平均表现最高，且在全部八项任务上超过最强固定交替基线。结果表明，依据信号质量协调策略与细则更新，有助于提升任务表现和细则区分力。
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based rewards provide fine-grained, interpretable supervision for open-ended reinforcement learning, where holistic scalar rewards struggle to capture multidimensional response quality. Static rubrics can lose discriminative power as the policy distribution evolves, while existing policy--rubric co-evolution methods rely on globally prescribed update schedules that ignore heterogeneous reward informativeness. We introduce RACE, a Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution framework. At the group level, per-rollout-group training-signal routing classifies groups as informative, diversity-collapsed, or rubric-failed, updating the policy only with informative groups while caching rubric failures. At the phase level, event-triggered phase switching enters rubric optimization upon persistent reward saturation and returns when rubric-reward improvement plateaus. Rubric phases train the generator on cached pairs using a frozen judge and a scale-normalized pairwise-margin reward. Across both levels, online threshold adaptation adjusts routing and switching thresholds through proportional control. Under a unified evaluation protocol, RACE achieves the highest average performance and outperforms the strongest fixed-alternation baseline on all eight tasks, while improving rubric discrimination.

papers.title_en: Hidden Disparities in Ranking: Category-Aware Fairness via Distributional Stability
papers.authors: Gayane Taturyan, Charlotte Laclau, Stephan Clémençon
papers.evidence: 研究推荐系统排序策略中的公平性与用户曝光
papers.tldr: 推荐排序中的总体效用公平可能掩盖不同物品类别内的群体差距，且群体构成变化会影响平均推荐质量。论文将排序策略建模为排列上的概率分布，以相对理想排序的交互物品曝光衡量用户效用，并引入类别条件效用平等。作者证明，总体与类别条件公平准则均等价于效用对群体构成变化的稳定性，并将策略混合优化转化为二阶锥规划。论文还给出泛化界并通过数值研究验证理论，为识别和缓解类别内隐藏差距提供统一框架。
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of fair ranking in recommender systems. We provide a formal probabilistic framework in which ranking policies are distributions over permutations, and the utility of a user is the exposure given to the items they interact with, relative to that of an ideal ranking. We consider utility parity across user groups, as well as its category-aware refinement, conditional utility parity, which requires parity within each category of items. Following a recent view of fairness as distributional stability, we show that both criteria are equivalent to the stability of the utility under changes in the composition of user groups. Optimizing over mixtures of ranking policies leads to a second-order cone program, for which we provide generalization bounds. A numerical study validates our theoretical findings.

papers.title_en: Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation
papers.authors: Zheng Zhu, Xiaozhuan Liang, Xi Chen, Bei Yu, Jiaya Jia
papers.evidence: 可调用的工作记忆工具支持进度与已核实事实的记录
papers.tldr: 长程任务中，工具反馈与失败尝试不断堆积，易使大语言模型智能体认知过载、推理退化。CORAL让智能体自主保存任务进度与已验证事实，再清空冗余上下文、开启新一轮求解，并通过多轮强化学习优化检查点能力。采用8B模型时，其在GAIA上平均准确率达42.8%，输入词元消耗仅为ReAct的约六至七分之一；还使强专有智能体在BrowseComp上提升8.0个百分点。研究展示了自主分配上下文资源对长程推理质量与效率的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.
